Wave AI Note Taker: Audio and Phone Call Recorder for Transcription, Note-Taking & More

Whether you're in a business meeting, classroom lecture, or on a call, Wave ensures you never miss a crucial detail.

With its seamless background audio recording, intelligent summaries, and powerful AI transcription, Wave simplifies meetings for maximum productivity.

Put AI into action today to capture, organize, and share your conversations.

WHAT CUSTOMERS SAY

"Honestly don't know how this app can do such a good job with taking notes of technical stuff and acronyms and things, but it does."

"Wave took down the people names, and somehow they were able to tell who is who when they spoke and they would put down the person name and 98 times out of 100 they were correct."

"Wave did capture all notes from the last two very complex design sessions and it very neatly clearly succinctly gave me a summary with next steps in the way it organized the notes was fantastic."

KEY FEATURES OF WAVE AI

Audio Recording & Transcription
- Wave works in the background, continuously capturing conversations without interrupting your workflow. Ideal for in-person meetings, lectures, and personal notes.
- Convert your recorded audio or phone calls into accurate, shareable text. Perfect for meetings, interviews, and dictation. Say goodbye to manually taking notes.
- Seamlessly record phone calls through the app and automatically generate detailed transcriptions and summaries, keeping your conversations organized and easy to reference.

Intelligent Summaries
- Wave's AI technology converts lengthy conversations into concise summaries, giving you the key takeaways at a glance. Focus on what matters most with actionable lists, notes, and to-dos.

Privacy & Security Focus
- With Wave, your recordings and transcriptions are fully secure. You control your data—easily export or delete any files when needed.

Unlimited Recording Time
- Wave allows you to record as much as you want, whether it's a short dictation or a long in-person meeting. You'll never have to worry about running out of time mid-conversation.

Easy Organization and Sharing
- Wave's intuitive interface lets you categorize and organize your recordings into easily searchable lists or memos, making it a perfect tool for students, professionals, and everyday use.
- Share your transcribed audio or text via URL, PDF, iMessage, and more. Keep your team, clients, or family in the loop with just a few taps.
- Set up Siri shortcuts or use the Action Button to instantly start recording a new meeting or note on the go.

Flexible Use Cases
- For professionals who need accurate meeting minutes or summaries of discussions. Wave is built for seamless recording of face-to-face conversations, making it easier to stay present and engaged.
- Students and educators record and transcribe lectures, classroom discussions, and personal study sessions with ease. Organize your notes for easy review before exams or group projects.
- Journalists use Wave to capture interviews with clear audio and convert them to text for easier editing and article writing.
- Whether you're using it as a notepad, memo recorder, or to capture important moments from your phone calls, Wave is versatile and easy to use for every type of user.

DESIGNED FOR MAXIMUM PRODUCTIVITY

Wave helps you get more done in less time:
- Boost productivity by focusing on the conversation, not on taking notes.
- Stay organized with searchable transcriptions and notes—easily find any word or topic without scrubbing through audio files.
- Export and share important meeting notes, memos, or interviews instantly to streamline your workflow.

Get Started with Wave Today
